name: Old-Fashioned Chicken Pot Pie with Flaky Crust
whyItWorks: While tender chicken breast and diced potatoes are gentle, the heavy cream roux sauce, buttery lard-shortened pastry crust, and whole peas/carrots can provoke cramping and diarrhea in active Crohn's disease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Caution: If dining in remission, eat the soft chicken and potato interior while leaving the dense whole peas and greasy bottom crust behind.
